description: High-tier Claude Solace. Sized so the BF16 checkpoint plus a 128k-context KV cache fits under a 48 GB RAM cap - targeting dual 24 GB consumer GPUs (2x RTX 3090/4090), a single NVIDIA A6000, or a Mac Studio / M3 Max with 64 GB unified memory. Same hybrid Gemma-4 + GPT-OSS architecture as the smaller variants, scaled up to ~18.8B parameters.

deployment.notes: Primary HF artifact is BF16 safetensors. At 8k ctx total runtime memory is ~40 GB; at 131k ctx ~43 GB thanks to sliding-window KV bounding for 5/6 of layers. A Q5_K_M GGUF and a bnb-int8 build are recommended companions for users pushing the context past 131k or running on 48 GB systems with other workloads active.
